annotation.title_clean: 全國法規資料庫會員服務介紹
annotation.title_en: Introduction to Member Services of the National Laws and Regulations Database
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 法務部 (Ministry of Justice, Taiwan) – 全國法規資料庫
annotation.venue: 全國法規資料庫 (Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: User guide for the member services of Taiwan's National Laws and Regulations Database: login via the My E-Government account, and saving, organising and deleting favourite regulations in personal folders. Despite the collector title referencing the AI Basic Act, the file contains no AI law text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Explains member registration via 'My E-Government' account
Describes saving regulations to personal folders
Describes creating, deleting folders and moving or deleting saved items
The file does not contain the text of the AI Basic Act
